description: This file defines the NodeAccessControlHandler class for managing access control for node entities in Drupal, including permission checks, grant management, and revision operations.

classes.name: NodeAccessControlHandler
classes.description: Defines the access control handler for node entities, managing permissions, grants, and revision access.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of NodeAccessControlHandler using dependency injection.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access for a given node entity and operation, considering permissions and grants.

methods.name: createAccess
methods.description: Checks create access for node entities based on user permissions.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Performs detailed access checks for node operations, including revision and grant checks.

methods.name: checkViewAccess
methods.description: Performs view access checks, especially for unpublished nodes and user permissions.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to create a node of a specific bundle.

methods.name: checkFieldAccess
methods.description: Checks access to edit specific fields of a node, such as status or administrative fields.

methods.name: acquireGrants
methods.description: Retrieves access grants for a node, allowing modules to alter grants.

methods.name: writeDefaultGrant
methods.description: Writes default grants to the storage.

methods.name: countGrants
methods.description: Counts the number of grants in storage.

methods.name: checkAllGrants
methods.description: Checks all grants for a user.
